sentences.en: It occurred to me that he might be an industrial spy.
sentences.zh: 我突然想到他可能是个工业间谍。

sentences.en: Since the Industrial Revolution, the world population has more than tripled.
sentences.zh: 自工业革命以来，世界人口已经超过了三倍。

sentences.en: Japan achieved a remarkable development in industrial technology after the war.
sentences.zh: 战后日本在工业技术方面取得了显著的发展。
